subject: Montara evaluation: security bridge, evidence cadence and DPA retention clarifications
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@montara.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Montara evaluation: security bridge, evidence cadence and DPA retention clarifications

Hi Natalie —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) that sequences the security/compliance checkpoints we expect in the evaluation and the approximate timelines for acceptance. Key items I want to surface now so we can lock expectations with your legal and security teams: 

- SOC 2 evidence readiness: our SOC 2 report (Type II) and control descriptions are included in the SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx. We can provide the report and log extracts for the last 12 months; for live evidence pulls (e.g., configuration screenshots, change history) we request a 3-business-day window to collect and redact any customer-specific identifiers.

- SIG/CAIQ: we can complete the CAIQ questionnaire and return a completed report within 5 business days after you confirm the scope items we flagged (API data flows, encryption-at-rest exceptions).

- DPA retention proposal: to avoid surprises, we proposed three retention tier options in the MAP: 30d (default PII purge), 90d (recommended for most pilots), 365d (enterprise archival). Please confirm which tier you expect for the pilot and what your archival/restore SLA would be if you choose the 365d option. Note: longer retention may require an escalation to our Dedicated or Private options for residency.

- Signing & legal timeline: can we aim for an initial DPA + SOW sign-off by 2028-04-28 to keep the technical sprint on-track for the May pilot start? If Montara legal needs alternate language, we flagged the most common carveouts in DPA-redline-summary.docx to speed redlines.

I attached the MAP draft and two supporting files (SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx and DPA-redline-summary.docx). Could you confirm the preferred retention tier and whether your legal team wants us to push an editable DPA via DocuSign or share a marked-up copy first?

Thanks — appreciate the clear beats on this.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (map outline), SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (evidence index), DPA-redline-summary.docx (common carveouts)
From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@montara.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@montara.com
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Montara evaluation: security bridge, evidence cadence and DPA retention clarifications

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the detailed MAP and the files — that helps. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Retention tier for pilot: Montara prefers the 90d option for pilot data. That gives our product team enough time to exercise edge cases without long-term archival costs.

2) SOC 2 evidence: 12-month report is fine; the 3-business-day window for ad-hoc evidence sounds reasonable to us. Can you call out which evidence types you anticipate needing that window for (e.g., access logs, ACL snapshots, audit trail exports)? Our security ops will prep.

3) DPA path: Legal prefers we start with a marked-up copy rather than DocuSign so we can do one pass with comments internally. I’ve looped in legal@montara.com.

Re timelines: 2028-04-28 sign-off is aggressive but doable if both sides stick to the review calendar. From Montara legal I expect a first pass by 2028-04-20; if there are heavy redlines we’ll push an internal recommend date.

-Natalie
Director of Platform Partnerships
Montara Systems

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Montara evaluation: security bridge, evidence cadence and DPA retention clarifications

Marcus / Soojin —

Echoing the ask from Natalie: we should prepare an evidence list that maps to the SOC 2 sections they care about (CC2, CC3, CC6). I started a short guidance note inside the SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (tab: requested-by-montara). Key calls: 

- Access logs & audit trails: we can export immutable logs for the pilot window; note that we redact internal token values but preserve request metadata.
- Configuration snapshots: 2 business days to gather and sanitize.
- Encryption material: we can provide high-level KMS usage and key rotation records; we cannot share raw key material.

On the DPA/redlines: legal@montara.com asked about retention semantics for backups and snapshots. We should be explicit: the retention tier applies to customer-data buckets and derived LLM-intermediate artifacts; automated system backups are retained for 7 days by default and are only used for disaster recovery — they are not available for customer restore beyond the retention tier unless we agree to an extended SLA. Please add that language to the DPA-redline-summary.docx: a short paragraph under section 4 (Data Retention & Backups).

I’ll prepare a marked-up DPA for their review by Tue 2028-04-19 EOD. Marcus — can you confirm the 3-business-day evidence window in the MAP and add an entry for the backup carveout?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Montara evaluation: security bridge, evidence cadence and DPA retention clarifications

All —

Quick update from Montara legal/security after internal review: 

- Retention: we confirm 90d for pilot data. We appreciate the backup carveout language; please include the 7-day disaster recovery retention note in your DPA mark-up.
- SOC 2 evidence: our security ops listed CC2 & CC6 as highest priority. They’ll send a short spreadsheet with exact field names they want pulled from logs; expect that by EOD tomorrow.
- DPA: legal marked a few non-substantive redlines (terminology alignments and an insurance threshold clarification). We’ll attach the marked DPA in a follow-up and aim for a final sign-off on 2028-04-28 if redlines are minor.

Next steps for Redwood: please send the edited DPA with the backup paragraph and confirm the evidence collection windows in the MAP (I want the timeline spelled out so our ops team can calendar it). If you can get those back to us by 2028-04-19 EOD that keeps the 4/28 target realistic.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot run.

-Natalie
Director of Platform Partnerships
Montara Systems
